status: template - copy, fill, verify on a small sample
sample_description: 13,821 U.S. adults, census-quota opt-in online panel, 2024; each read one short climate message or one of three off-topic control texts; all outcomes 0-100 integer sliders measured pre and post.

Belief_Post.question: belief that human activity causes climate change (3 items, item 3 reversed)

Concern_Post.question: climate concern (3 items) - VERBATIM the target's concern_1..3

Policies_Post.question: general climate policy support (3 items) - includes the target's policy_general verbatim

PoliciesSp_Post.question: specific climate policy support (4 items, item 3 reversed)

IntentNp_Post.question: non-political climate behaviour intentions (6 items) - 3 verbatim target behavior_* items

Donation.question: allocation of 100 cents to climate orgs (0-100, strongly bimodal)

moderators_unavailable.race: present only in 'CCC - Data - Deidentified.csv'; there is NO respondent id, so the join is positional and UNVERIFIED - do not use until row alignment is demonstrated
moderators_unavailable.education: raw file has 5 levels; the target's Master's vs Doctorate split is not recoverable
moderators_unavailable.income: Income_B codes 1-11 have no label table anywhere on disk - unusable

message_texts_source: /workspace/datasets/voelkel2026/downloads/CCC - Questionnaire - Qualtrics.pdf (all 13 arm texts; extract with pypdf in the `texts` stage). NOT the other questionnaire PDF, which lists names only.

caveats: outcomes measured pre and post; use post-minus-control for a like-for-like ATE, and control-arm PRE distributions as unprimed baselines
reverse scoring already applied in the recoded file - do not reverse twice
treatment length varies 1-11 pages: dose is confounded with content
no trust-in-scientists outcome of any kind
provenance.twin_note: Its three control texts are the SAME three filler texts the target study uses (neckties / baseball / dances). Structural fact from the two instruments, not outcome data.
